title: Error VPN-719
text: Error VPN-719 means your VPN certificate has expired. Open the Self-Service portal, choose Renew Certificate, then restart the VPN client.

title: VPN keeps disconnecting
text: If the VPN connection drops every few minutes, switch from Wi-Fi to a wired network and update the client to the latest version. Hotel and airport networks often block the VPN protocol.

title: Error SSO-204
text: Error SSO-204 appears when your single sign-on session token is rejected because your device clock is wrong. Set the clock to update automatically and sign in again.

title: Resetting your password
text: To reset a forgotten password, go to the sign-in page and choose Forgot password. You will get a code by text message. Passwords must be at least 14 characters.

title: Laptop replacement
text: Laptops are replaced every four years. If your laptop is broken or very slow before then, file a hardware ticket and IT will lend you a spare while it is repaired.

title: Lost or stolen devices
text: Report a lost or stolen laptop or phone to the IT security desk within 24 hours. IT will wipe the device remotely and issue a replacement.

title: Printer error PRN-33
text: Printer error PRN-33 means the print queue is paused. Ask the office manager to resume the queue from the print server console.

title: Installing software
text: Only software from the approved catalog may be installed. To request a new application, submit form IT-12 with the business reason and the vendor's security documentation.

title: Parental leave
text: Employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave after the birth or adoption of a child. Leave can be split into two blocks within the first year.

title: Annual leave
text: Full-time employees accrue 25 days of annual leave per year. Up to 5 unused days carry over to the next year; the rest expire on December 31.

title: Sick days
text: Take the time you need when you are ill. For absences longer than five working days, send your manager a note from a doctor.

title: Working from abroad
text: You may work from another country for up to 30 days per year with your manager's approval. Longer stays need a tax review by the People team first.

title: Referral bonus
text: If someone you refer is hired and stays for six months, you receive a referral bonus of 2,000 dollars in the next payroll run.

title: Performance reviews
text: Performance reviews happen twice a year, in March and September. Your manager collects peer feedback through the Pulse tool two weeks before each review.

title: Form HR-9 for name changes
text: To change your legal name in payroll and the directory, submit form HR-9 with a copy of the supporting document. Changes take effect in the next pay period.

title: Expense reimbursement
text: Submit receipts for business expenses in the Expenses app within 60 days. Approved claims are paid with your next salary.

title: Client meals and entertainment
text: Meals with clients are covered up to 90 dollars per person, including tax and tip. Alcohol may not exceed a third of the bill. List every attendee on the claim.

title: Travel booking
text: Book flights and hotels through the Atlas travel portal. Economy class is required for flights under six hours; business class needs a director's approval.

title: Per diem rates
text: When traveling overnight you may claim a daily allowance for food instead of receipts. The rate depends on the city and is listed in the Atlas portal.

title: Purchase orders
text: Purchases above 5,000 dollars need a purchase order. Raise it in the procurement system; the PO number starts with PO- followed by the year, for example PO-2026-01182.

title: Corporate cards
text: Corporate cards are issued to employees who travel at least monthly. Personal purchases on the card are not allowed and must be repaid within 10 days.

title: Invoice disputes
text: If a supplier invoice looks wrong, do not pay it. Reply to the supplier with the invoice number and copy the accounts payable team, who will place it on hold.

title: Phishing
text: If an email asks for your password or urgent payment, do not click any links. Use the Report Phish button in your mail client so the security team can investigate.

title: Visitor access
text: Visitors must be registered at reception the day before and wear a badge at all times. Escort them in areas beyond the lobby.

title: Data classification
text: Documents are labeled Public, Internal, Confidential, or Restricted. Restricted data, such as salary information, may only be shared with named individuals.

title: Booking meeting rooms
text: Reserve meeting rooms in the calendar app. Rooms not checked into within 10 minutes are released automatically for others to use.

title: Parking
text: The office garage has 40 spaces assigned by lottery each quarter. Electric vehicle chargers on level 2 are first come, first served.

title: Office hours and after-hours access
text: The building is open from 7 am to 8 pm on weekdays. For evening or weekend entry, request after-hours access from facilities at least one day ahead.

title: Error VPN-722
text: Error VPN-722 means the VPN gateway rejected your login because multi-factor approval timed out. Approve the prompt on your phone within 60 seconds and connect again.

title: Error VPN-801
text: Error VPN-801 appears when the VPN client is older than the minimum supported version. Install the update from the Self-Service portal.

title: Error SSO-209
text: Error SSO-209 means your account is locked after too many failed sign-in attempts. Wait 30 minutes or ask the IT service desk to unlock it.

title: Error SSO-310
text: Error SSO-310 means the application you are opening is not assigned to you. Ask your manager to request access in the Self-Service portal.

title: Printer error PRN-38
text: Printer error PRN-38 means the printer is out of toner. Replacement cartridges are in the supply cabinet next to each printer.

title: Printer error PRN-41
text: Printer error PRN-41 is a paper jam in tray 2. Open the side panel, remove the paper, and close the panel firmly.

title: Form IT-14 for admin rights
text: Temporary administrator rights on your laptop require form IT-14, approved by your manager. Rights expire after 7 days.

title: Form IT-19 for shared mailboxes
text: To request a shared mailbox for a team, submit form IT-19 with the list of members and an owner.

title: Form HR-6 for address changes
text: Update your home address with form HR-6 so payroll and tax documents reach you. It takes effect immediately.

title: Form HR-11 for bank details
text: To change the bank account your salary is paid into, submit form HR-11. Changes made after the 20th apply to the following month.

title: Purchase order approvals
text: Every purchase order needs approval from the budget owner. POs above 50,000 dollars also need the finance director's sign-off.

title: Supplier onboarding
text: New suppliers must complete the vendor questionnaire and pass a security review before their first purchase order is issued.

title: Remote access security
text: Never share your VPN credentials. Remote access sessions are logged, and sessions idle for 30 minutes are disconnected.

title: Lost and found
text: Items left in meeting rooms or the kitchen are kept at reception for two weeks before being donated.
